description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-exceptions.html, decision 2, ticket 2. No runtime change.

Build: in body.rs, `try do B after A end` lowers as the nested-try form v3_core uses (after body on the success path after the pop, and in a handler whose only row runs A then re-raises the original kind and value); `try do B rescue/catch ... after A end` is two nested trys; `else` arms are a case over the body's value outside the protected region, whose miss raises TryClauseError with the value; a try with only do and else is the Elixir warning/error. Body and after bindings do not escape.

Acceptance (interp, run, build; elixir oracle):
- after runs on success and its value is discarded (try's value is the body's).
- after runs on a raise, then the outer rescue sees the ORIGINAL exception.
- an exception raised inside after masks the original.
- else matches the body's value; a miss raises TryClauseError "no try clause matching: <value>" not caught by the same try's rescue; a raise inside an else arm is not caught by the same try.
- try with rescue and after: rescue handles, after still runs once.
- a variable bound in the body is unbound after the try: expected.diagnostics fixture.
- unit tests for the desugaring shape (the lowered step structure: nested handlers, one after block, no second runtime concept).
- exceptions doc gains the after/else section; fixtures.md updated.
- gate green as in the epic.
title: after and else are desugarings of try
